findings: The declared environment is default modmain/modimport, which supplies GLOBAL. Runtime names are explicitly reached through GLOBAL.
World is looked up inside ConfigureExample at each invocation; no pre-world module-load snapshot is retained.
Nil world and non-master returns precede any component mutation. Supplied item, consumer function, component and enum premises are clear.
The helper configures PLANT/MEDIUM on an existing server deployable and binds one project-provided consumer; its true means configuration succeeded.
Input entity and product/consume callback are caller-supplied placeholders. The helper supplies neither item creation nor hook registration, and does not present itself as a full drop-in Mod.
Consumer return false remains ignored by vanilla Deploy; unique consumer ownership and project-specific failure policy remain explicit.
